title: Make a countdown using a while loop
description: Start with a number of your choice. Use while to print the number and subtract 1 each time until the countdown reaches 0. After the loop, print a final message such as "Go!".
solution:
number = 3
while number > 0:
    print(number)
    number -= 1
print("Go!")

title: Use while to add a range of numbers
description: Create a counter and a total variable. Use while to add the counter to the total, increase the counter each time, and stop when you reach your chosen limit. Print the total.
solution:
total = 0
number = 1
while number <= 4:
    total += number
    number += 1
print(total)

title: Count the digits in a whole number using while
description: Choose a positive whole number. Use a while loop and // 10 to remove the last digit each time, while increasing a counter. Print how many digits the number had.
solution:
number = 5821
count = 0
while number > 0:
    count += 1
    number //= 10
print(count)
